body:
Users had no way to preview the frontend without a Supabase database ΓÇö the root route requires server-side auth, Three.js components crashed on SSR, and `AuthProvider` hung for 4 seconds making network calls to `placeholder.supabase.co`.

## No-DB instant fallback
`isSupabaseConfigured()` already existed in `src/lib/supabase/client.ts` but was never wired into `AuthProvider`. Now auth resolution is immediate when no credentials are set:
```ts
if (!isSupabaseConfigured()) {
  setState({ user: null, profile: null, isLoading: false, isAuthenticated: false, isGuest: true })
  return // no network calls, no 4s timeout
}
```

## SSR crash fix
Next.js App Router SSRs `'use client'` components. `@react-three/postprocessing`, Three.js, and OrbitControls are not SSR-safe. All three WebGL preview pages now use `next/dynamic(..., { ssr: false })`.

## HeroWebGL runtime fixes
- **Uniforms** ΓÇö inline `uniforms={{...}}` on `<shaderMaterial>` was a new object every render; R3F clobbered the map, breaking `uTime` animation. Extracted to `useMemo`, mutated directly in `useFrame`.
- **Suspense** ΓÇö `<Text>` and `<Environment>` both suspend for async resources (font/HDR). Wrapped each in `<Suspense fallback={null}>` inside the Canvas.
- **Font CDN** ΓÇö `<Text>` defaulted to Google Fonts, blocked by Vercel CSP. Changed to jsDelivr.
- **ErrorBoundary** ΓÇö uncaught errors now surface visibly instead of blank screen.

## New preview routes (no auth)
| Route | Renders |
|---|---|
| `/preview` | Full `LandingPage` ΓÇö ParticleLanding 3D + overlay |
| `/hero-webgl-preview` | `HeroWebGL` ΓÇö wave-thread shader, SoulCore, Wordmark3D |
| `/neon-cube-preview` | `NeonGlassCube` with runtime toggles |
| `/previews` | Hub page with live Vercel + local URLs for all routes |

## Netlify Drop static bundle
`netlify-preview/` ΓÇö four self-contained HTML files (CDN Three.js, no build step, no DB):
- `index.html` ΓÇö hub
- `neon-cube.html` ΓÇö neon glass cube with OrbitControls
- `hero-webgl.html` ΓÇö wave-thread field + SoulCore + canvas-texture wordmark
- `landing.html` ΓÇö particle starfield + full overlay

`.github/workflows/build-netlify-preview.yml` zips the folder and uploads it as a downloadable Actions artifact on every push.

## New component: `HeroWebGL`
Premium R3F scene: 42├ù180 `lineSegments` wave-thread field (custom GLSL vertex/fragment shader), pulsing mercury-orange emissive `SoulCore` sphere, per-letter Drei `<Text>` wordmark inside `<Float>`. Accepts optional `height` prop (default `'520px'`).
